facts.fact: Tilde 自认是她选择把众人带出林子，而不是任他们在黑暗里自相残杀。
facts.anchor: I had chosen to bring them out of the woods.

facts.fact: Hadiah 告诉她，她已在 Widdin 宫中昏迷五天，几乎死掉。
facts.anchor: It has been five days. Five days, Tilde. You almost died.

facts.fact: Hadiah 说 Dagobert 两天前失踪了。
facts.anchor: Dagobert is gone, disappeared two days ago.

facts.fact: Isen 的葬礼就在当天上午已经办完。
facts.anchor: ‘It was this morning,’ Hadiah told me.

facts.fact: Merovin 的密信说鸟群惊慌、即将行动，要她做好准备。
facts.anchor: The birds are panicked, they will move soon. When they come for you, be ready.

facts.fact: 她笑，是因为大王子 Alar 打算娶她。
facts.anchor: because the eldest prince intends to marry me

facts.fact: 她断言 Alar 才是得知血魔法之后重新打开那道门的人。
facts.anchor: He was the one who reopened the gates to their blood magic after he learned of it.

facts.fact: 敲门的人是国王的将军 Palati Odon，不是普通来客。
facts.anchor: Not just any man. Palati Odon.
